findings.claim: Marvell FY27 Q2 資料中心營收 $2.17B、年增 46%、占總營收 79%；報導稱全年資料中心成長預期由約 50% 上修至約 60%、全年營收約 $12B（各報導數字不一，未見公司原始公告）
findings.source: Futurum Group, Marvell Q2 FY 2027: Connectivity and Custom Silicon Fuel AI Growth / Pulse2

findings.claim: Marvell 稱 FY2028 客製化營收將超過倍增，並重申 FY2029 客製化矽營收目標逾 $100 億
findings.source: Futurum Group, Marvell Q1/Q2 FY 2027 coverage

findings.claim: Interconnect 業務 FY2027 預期成長逾 70%（原約 50%）；1.6T 方案已量產並於 FY2027 快速放量
findings.source: Futurum Group, Marvell Q1 FY 2027 Raises Full-Year Outlook
findings.excerpt: Marvell expects its interconnect business to grow more than 70% YoY in FY 2027

findings.claim: Counterpoint 預估 Marvell 在客製 AI ASIC 的份額 2027 年降至約 8%（出貨量 2024–2027 約倍增）；JPMorgan 估 Broadcom 占高階 ASIC 80–85%、Marvell 約 10–12%；Motley Fool 引 Broadcom 約 70%
findings.source: Counterpoint Research / JPMorgan via KuCoin / Motley Fool
findings.excerpt: Broadcom is the bigger player in custom AI chips with an estimated market share of 70%.

findings.claim: 自 FY26 Q4 起，企業網路、電信基礎設施、消費、車用/工業合併為單一 communications and other 終端市場；車用乙太網路事業以 $2.5B 售予 Infineon，2025-08-14 完成
findings.excerpt: Beginning in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company consolidated revenue previously reported separately as enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, consumer and automotive/industrial end markets into a new communications and other end market

findings.claim: 分析師指 Marvell PAM4 DSP 在可插拔光學相對領先（定性，無量化份額）；較早的疑慮含 Trainium 份額流失、1.6T DSP 放量時程、Broadcom 競爭
findings.source: Investing.com, Marvell SWOT analysis: stock surges on optical growth
findings.excerpt: Marvell's PAM4 DSP is relatively leading in pluggable optics.

end_markets.note: As_of 為依來源發布時點之估計日期（搜尋摘要未顯示確切日）；comms-and-other 分部 FY26 全年與 Q4 數字、光學 DSP 量化份額、獨立 TAM 共識皆未找到（none）。僅用 4 次搜尋。
